create_visualizer_gui: create a Visualizer instance with GUI renderer type for interactive 3D human mesh visualization
create_visualizer_nongui: create a Visualizer instance with nongui renderer type for headless offscreen rendering via xvfb
visualize_screenless_naive: render SMPL mesh list and skeleton list from camera and side view in screenless mode
visualize_gui_naive: display SMPL mesh list and skeleton list overlaid on an original image in GUI mode
visualize_gui_smplpose_basic: visualize SMPL vertices from a list of pose parameters with optional shape and color
